description: Rewrites interface microcopy so users understand it: error messages, empty states, button and CTA labels, confirmation dialogs, form labels and hints, tooltips, loading and success messages. Use when the user pastes UI text to improve, mentions confusing errors, vague Submit or OK buttons, unclear labels, or writing for non-technical users. Not for marketing or landing-page copy (use copywriting).
